english.title: Sell / exchange a live / dead / part / derivative of a wild animal of Annex IV(a) listed species / subspecies
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold or exchanged

(A)_[a live]_
(B)_[a dead]_
(C)_[part of an]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY..) that had been derived from an]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY..) that had been derived from part of an]_

wild animal which had been taken from the wild and which was of a species or subspecies listed in Annex IV(a) to the Habitats Directive, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 43(3)(c) and (8) of the Conservation of Natural Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Schedule 2 to the Conservation of Natural Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 lists those species of animals listed in Annex IV(a) to the Habitats Directive which have a natural range which includes any area in Great Britain.
